name: Cama inBox
description: Brazilian online store specialised in mattresses, beds and box-spring bases, sofas, sofa-beds, armchairs, pillows and accessories. Its homepage states that it delivers to all of Brazil; no states or shipping rules are listed there.

ships_to.notes: Homepage says it delivers to all of Brazil. No state list or shipping rules shown on the homepage.
